dedupe_keys.name: data underlying the publication the potential impact of human interventions at different scales in offshore wind farms to promote flat oyster ostrea edulis reef development in the southern north sea

description: TU Delft and Van Oord provide inputs and assessment outputs for interventions intended to promote flat-oyster reefs in offshore wind farms. The source covers southern North Sea wind farms and their infrastructure present through 31 December 2020, alongside designated future wind-farm areas. It describes location-specific physical conditions and quantitative estimates for alternative interventions based on assumptions from earlier studies. Coverage: Complete observation dates and geographic extent are unstated.. Access: public native metadata describes the identified research release. Licence: CC0-1.0. Current file access and cost are unknown. Related resources have separately identified native releases. Caveats: The source cites owner and website information, 4COffshore and EMODnet. These upstream inventories were not reacquired. Designated future areas remain distinct from operating infrastructure. Country extent is not fully enumerated by the source and is kept unknown. Assessment assumptions and ecological outcomes were not independently checked. Its simulation use concerns the specified wind-infrastructure intervention assessment.
